note: System-design prompts for GenAI interviews. A company is listed only where the cited source says that company asked it; the outlines are our own study notes.

prompts.title: Batching for LLM inference
prompts.prompt: Design an inference batching system for one GPU that serves up to 100 synchronous requests per batch.

source.title: 45+ AI Engineer Interview Questions & Answers (Aced, formerly Exponent)

mustCover: Batch formation rule: size cap plus max wait
Why continuous batching beats static batching
KV-cache memory as the real limit on batch size
Metrics: time in queue, batch fill, p99 latency
outline: Clarify load, latency target and request length distribution
Describe the queue and the batch-forming rule (size or deadline)
Explain static versus continuous batching and pick one
Bound memory: tokens per batch and KV-cache budget
Handle failures of one request without killing the batch
Expose metrics and tune the wait time against the latency target
followUps: What changes when requests have very different lengths?
How do you keep interactive users from waiting behind bulk jobs?
How would you scale beyond one GPU?

prompts.title: API for hosted models
prompts.prompt: Design the API developers use to access a family of hosted language models.

source.title: Anthropic technical interview questions guide (Jobright)

mustCover: Stable request and response contract with streaming
API keys, scopes, quotas and rate limits
outline: Clarify users, scale and the features needed on day one
Define the request, response and streaming format
Add authentication, per-key limits and quotas
Describe routing to serving clusters, batching and failover
Cover metering, logging and privacy
Explain versioning and how changes are rolled out
followUps: How do you add a new model without breaking clients?
How do you stop one customer starving the rest?
What do you log, and what do you never log?

prompts.title: LLM API with a safety layer
prompts.prompt: Design an API for an LLM with a safety layer. Discuss batching against latency, and how to update the safety layer without downtime.

source.title: Anthropic technical interview questions guide (Jobright)

mustCover: Separate input and output safety stages
Latency hiding: parallel or streamed checks
Versioned safety models with shadow testing
Measuring false positives and false negatives
outline: Define what the safety layer must catch and the latency budget
Place input and output checks around the model
Show how checks run in parallel or on streamed chunks
Describe blue-green or canary rollout of the new safety model
Explain shadow traffic to compare old and new decisions
Describe monitoring and the appeal path for wrong blocks
followUps: What if the safety model is slower than the main model?
How do you handle a streaming response that becomes unsafe midway?
Who signs off on threshold changes?

prompts.title: GPU scheduling with credits
prompts.prompt: Design a GPU scheduling system that uses credits. Cover preemption, preventing monopolisation and node failures.

source.title: Anthropic technical interview questions guide (Jobright)

mustCover: Credit accounting as an auditable event log
Fair sharing and limits per user or team
outline: Clarify job types, durations and fairness goals
Model credits: grants, reservations, charges, expiry
Design the scheduler and queue ordering
Define preemption and when jobs checkpoint
Handle node failures and job retries
Add observability and abuse protection
followUps: How do you stop a user from hoarding credits?
What happens to credits on a preempted job?
How would you test the scheduler?

prompts.title: A ChatGPT-style assistant
prompts.prompt: Design ChatGPT: a chat assistant with streamed answers and saved conversation history for a very large user base.

source.title: Generative AI system design interview guide (IGotAnOffer)

mustCover: Gateway with authentication and rate limits
Serving tier with batching and capacity planning
Graceful degradation when capacity is short

Sketch client, gateway, conversation service and model tier
Explain streaming and how history is stored
Cover safety checks and abuse limits
Discuss capacity, caching and regional scaling

How do you protect user privacy in stored chats?
How would you add file uploads?
